hook: 좋은 배우는 진짜로 운다|그리고 컷 하면 돌아온다

assets.style: Painterly cinematic illustration, mystical and dramatic, deep violet and indigo night with radiant gold light, high contrast, vertical 9:16 composition with one clear subject in the center, no text, no letters, no watermark.

voices.name: l00
voices.text: 좋은 배우는, <#0.2#> 슬픈 장면에서 진짜로 울어요.
voices.caption: 좋은 배우는, 슬픈 장면에서 진짜로 울어요.

voices.name: l01
voices.text: 하지만 컷 소리가 나면, <#0.3#> 자기 자신으로 돌아와요.
voices.caption: 하지만 컷 소리가 나면, 자기 자신으로 돌아와요.

voices.name: l02
voices.text: 배역을 경험한 거지, <#0.2#> 배역이 된 게 아니니까요.
voices.caption: 배역을 경험한 거지, 배역이 된 게 아니니까요.

voices.name: l03
voices.text: 화가 날 때, <#0.2#> 나는 화났어, 대신 이렇게 말해 보세요.
voices.caption: 화가 날 때, 나는 화났어, 대신 이렇게 말해 보세요.

voices.name: l04
voices.text: 지금 내 안에 분노가, <#0.2#> 지나가고 있구나.
voices.caption: 지금 내 안에 분노가, 지나가고 있구나.

images: an actress on a dark theater stage under a single spotlight, tears on her face as she performs a grief-stricken scene
the same actress backstage wiping her tears, a calm peaceful smile, soft warm light around her
a person in a dark room with a red storm of anger swirling around them, while their calm golden true self stands one step behind, watching
a calm person standing in soft golden light, the red storm dissolving into drifting sparks

animate.motion: the actress weeps in the spotlight, tears run down her face, the spotlight slowly widens into warm light
